# cubepath_managed_database_user (Resource)

Manages a user inside a managed database. The platform grants its standard privileges; they cannot be customized. The password can never be read back from the API: it is kept in the Terraform state only. Import with managed_database_id/user_id (the password imports empty).



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `managed_database_id` (String) UUID of the managed database. Changing it forces a new user.
- `username` (String) Username: up to 32 lowercase letters, numbers and underscores, starting with a letter. Changing it forces a new user.

### Optional

- `password` (String, Sensitive) Password, 12 to 64 characters. Omit it to let the platform generate one. Changing it recreates the user.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The UUID of the user.
- `status` (String) Status: pending, active, error or deleting.
